title: [Bug] Tool use notifications triggered for all invocations instead of input-only
body:
**Bug Description**
I suddenly started getting a lot of notifications for every single tool use. I am on iTerm2, and it only used to send a notification when it needs my input

**Environment Info**
- Platform: darwin
- Terminal: iTerm.app
- Version: 2.0.53
- Feedback ID: 7afac898-a3a3-44e6-99e0-5a738547cccb

**Errors**
```json
[{"error":"ZodError: [
  {
    "code": "unrecognized_keys",
    "keys": [
      "plan"
    ],
    "path": [],
    "message": "Unrecognized key(s) in object: 'plan'"
  }
]
    at get error (file:///Users/mert/.claude/local/node_modules/@anthropic-ai/claude-code/cli.js:74:18431)
    at $Y.parse (file:///Users/mert/.claude/local/node_modules/@anthropic-ai/claude-code/cli.js:74:11700)
    at YT3 (file:///Users/mert/.claude/local/node_modules/@anthropic-ai/claude-code/cli.js:4007:4747)
    at process.processTicksAndRejections (node:internal/process/task_queues:105:5)
    at async G$ (file:///Users/mert/.claude/local/node_modules/@anthropic-ai/claude-code/cli.js:4007:6259)","timestamp":"2025-11-25T08:46:16.740Z"}]
```
author: mrtysn

top_comments.body: We've just pushed a new build v2.0.54 with a fix for this! Sorry for the inconvenience
